Initial release of Video Editing with OBS.

- Instantly edit and export OBS recordings via a simple prompt—no editing software required.
- Upload MP4, MKV, MOV, or AVI files up to 500MB for AI-powered video editing (cut dead air, transitions, highlight reels).
- Fully automated setup using anonymous token for free access (100 credits, 7-day expiry).
- Cloud rendering pipeline delivers quick export (1–2 minutes) in 1080p MP4 and other formats.
- Supports seamless credit and session management, error handling, and easy project iteration.
- Optimized for streamers/content creators who want fast cleanup of screen recordings.
